keyPoints.en: Renewable: forests (if managed), water, solar, wind. Non-renewable: petroleum, gas, coal, tin.
keyPoints.bm: Boleh diperbaharui: hutan (jika diurus), air, suria, angin. Tidak boleh diperbaharui: petroleum, gas, arang batu, bijih timah.

keyPoints.en: Use resources wisely and develop renewable energy.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan sumber dengan bijak dan bangunkan tenaga boleh diperbaharui.

keyPoints.en: Pollution: air (haze, vehicles, factories), water (waste, sewage), land (rubbish).
keyPoints.bm: Pencemaran: udara (jerebu, kenderaan, kilang), air (sisa, kumbahan), tanah (sampah).

keyPoints.en: API: 0–50 good, 51–100 moderate, 101–200 unhealthy, 201–300 very unhealthy, >300 hazardous.
keyPoints.bm: IPU: 0–50 baik, 51–100 sederhana, 101–200 tidak sihat, 201–300 sangat tidak sihat, >300 berbahaya.

keyPoints.en: Global warming (CO₂, methane) raises sea levels; CFCs thin the ozone layer; deforestation causes floods and landslides.
keyPoints.bm: Pemanasan global (CO₂, metana) menaikkan aras laut; CFC menipiskan lapisan ozon; penebangan hutan menyebabkan banjir dan tanah runtuh.

keyPoints.en: Sustainable development balances economy, society and environment.
keyPoints.bm: Pembangunan lestari mengimbangi ekonomi, sosial dan alam sekitar.

keyPoints.en: Actions: laws (Environmental Quality Act 1974, DOE), technology, 3R, regional cooperation on haze.
keyPoints.bm: Tindakan: undang-undang (Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974, JAS), teknologi, 3K, kerjasama serantau tentang jerebu.
